title.narrative: HIV/AIDS Response for Key Populations and Community TB Programme in High Burden Areas in Liberia - Liberia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Liberia, TB/HIV, Plan International, Inc. (Plan International Liberia)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections by 90% to less than 200 by 2026. Reduce stigma and discrimination for PLHIV and vulnerable populations to less than 20%. Strengthen multisectoral monitoring, reporting, and evaluation of the national AIDS and TB response. Institute bold policies and supportive systems for TB care and prevention. To provide high-quality TB preventive, diagnostic and treatment services to all patients without their having to incur catastrophic costs. The objectives of this program are: Scale up HIV interventions to reach 60% of estimated Key Populations and vulnerable groups. Eliminate mother to child transmission of HIV to less than 2%. Zero denial of health services based on perceived or positive HIV status. 90% of Persons living with HIV have access to justice and can challenge rights violations. Community system and CSO are strengthened and contribute significantly to accelerating the response. Quality strategic information on HIV, AIDS, TB and TB/HIV is produced and used for decision-making. Ensure TB case notification coverage is ≥90% by 2026. Increase the proportion of community contribution to TB case notification to 28% of all cases notified annually by 2026. Increase TB treatment success rate to ≥90% in 2026. Increase DR-TB treatment coverage to 95% in 2026. Increase uptake of ART among HIV-positive TB patients (new and relapse) to ≥90% by 2026
